name: Upscale.media
summary: Browser AI image upscaler (a PixelBin product) that enlarges and enhances photos on a monthly credit allowance or one-time credit packs.
description: Browser AI image upscaler (a PixelBin product) that enlarges and enhances photos on a monthly credit allowance or one-time credit packs.

pricing.details: Free — 3 free credits and 3 free downloads every month. Subscription 0.01 €/credit, 63.53 € billed yearly (auto-renews yearly, cancel anytime). One-time packs valid 1 year, non-refundable: 60 credits 7.25 € (0.12 €/credit), 125 credits 10.88 € (0.09 €/credit), 500 credits 27.22 € (0.05 €/credit), 1,200 credits 49.91 € (0.04 €/credit). Enterprise is talk-to-sales. Official prices already in euro, shown as published. The page states they do not offer refunds because of AI costs and asks you to try Free first.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Browser AI image upscaler, a PixelBin product, with face enhancements
Free plan: 3 credits and 3 downloads every month
Yearly subscription billed at 63.53 €, or one-time credit packs valid 1 year
API integration mentioned; Enterprise is talk-to-sales
